name: RenkoLineBreakVsRSI_EA
summary: This EA trades based on the RenkoLineBreak indicator trend direction confirmed by RSI divergence from the 50 level. It places buy stop or sell stop pending orders when the RenkoLineBreak shows a sustained trend and RSI is sufficiently far from the midpoint. Positions are closed when the trend reverses or RSI crosses the opposite threshold.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RenkoLineBreak指标的趋势方向并结合RSI偏离50中线的程度进行交易。当RenkoLineBreak显示持续趋势且RSI远离中点时，放置买入止损或卖出止损挂单。当趋势反转或RSI穿越相反阈值时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用RenkoLineBreak指标判断趋势方向，并结合RSI指标作为过滤条件。RenkoLineBreak指标通过自定义指标缓冲区2的值来判断趋势状态：正值表示上升趋势，负值表示下降趋势，趋势转换用TO_UP和TO_DOWN表示。入场条件为：当趋势为UP且RSI低于50减去垂直偏移量时开多单，当趋势为DOWN且RSI高于50加上垂直偏移量时开空单，这是一种趋势确认加动量回调的策略逻辑。出场条件为：当趋势转为TO_DOWN或RSI超过50加偏移时平多仓，当趋势转为TO_UP或RSI低于50减偏移时平空仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，通过挂单（Buy Stop/Sell Stop）入场，挂单价格基于前3根K线的高低点加上偏移量确定。止损设在前3根K线的极值处加减偏移量，止盈为固定点数。资金管理方面提供了固定手数和固定百分比两种模式枚举，但实际代码中仅使用了固定手数InpVolume，未实现MoneyFixedLot的调用。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses the RenkoLineBreak custom indicator to determine trend direction, confirmed by RSI divergence from the 50 midpoint as a filter. RenkoLineBreak reads buffer index 2 values: positive indicates uptrend, negative indicates downtrend, with TO_UP/TO_DOWN representing trend transitions. Entry conditions are: open a buy stop when trend is UP and RSI is below 50 minus the vertical shift, or open a sell stop when trend is DOWN and RSI is above 50 plus the vertical shift — this is a trend-confirmation-with-momentum-pullback logic. Exit conditions are: close longs when trend transitions to TO_DOWN or RSI exceeds 50 plus the shift, and close shorts when trend transitions to TO_UP or RSI falls below 50 minus the shift. Position sizing uses a fixed lot volume specified by InpVolume, with pending stop orders placed at prices derived from the high/low of the previous 3 bars plus an indent offset. Stop loss is set at the extreme of the previous 3 bars plus/minus indent, and take profit is a fixed pip distance. Although the code declares an MM_MODE enum with FIXED_LOT and FIXED_PERCENT options and includes MoneyFixedLot.mqh, it never actually instantiates or uses the money management class, relying solely on the input volume parameter.

parameters.description_en: Minimum box size for RenkoLineBreak indicator

parameters.name: InpRsiVShift
parameters.description: RSI相对于50中线的垂直偏移量，用于过滤信号
parameters.description_en: RSI vertical offset from 50 midline for signal filtering

parameters.name: InpIndentFromHL
parameters.description: 挂单价格距离最高/最低价的偏移点数
parameters.description_en: Pending order offset from high/low in points

pros: 使用双指标过滤（RenkoLineBreak趋势+RSI动量），减少假信号
采用挂单入场机制，价格确认后才成交，避免追价
有明确的止损和止盈设置，每笔交易风险可控
趋势反转时自动删除旧挂单并平仓，避免逆势持仓
pros_en: Dual-indicator filtration (RenkoLineBreak trend + RSI momentum) reduces false signals
Pending order entry mechanism ensures price confirmation before execution, avoiding chase entries
Explicit stop loss and take profit settings provide defined risk per trade
Automatically deletes old pending orders and closes positions on trend reversal, avoiding counter-trend exposure
cons: MM_MODE枚举声明了FIXED_PERCENT模式但未实现，代码与声明不一致
包含了MoneyFixedLot.mqh但从未使用，存在冗余依赖
DeleteAllOrders函数在删除订单时遍历列表的同时删除元素，可能导致跳过订单
CheckPosition函数中使用PositionGetInteger但未先调用PositionSelect，可能获取不到正确仓位信息
没有滑点保护和点差过滤，在极端行情下可能产生意外成交价格
cons_en: MM_MODE enum declares FIXED_PERCENT mode but it is never implemented, creating a mismatch between interface and code
MoneyFixedLot.mqh is included but never used, leaving a redundant dependency
DeleteAllOrders iterates the order list while deleting elements, which can skip orders due to index shifting
CheckPosition uses PositionGetInteger without first calling PositionSelect on the correct ticket, potentially reading stale position data
No slippage protection or spread filter, which may cause unexpected fill prices during volatile conditions
improvements: 实现FIXED_PERCENT资金管理模式或移除未使用的枚举和包含文件，保持代码一致性
修复DeleteAllOrders函数中的遍历删除问题，应从后向前遍历或使用单独收集ticket再删除
在CheckPosition中先通过PositionSelect选择正确仓位再获取仓位属性，确保数据准确
增加点差过滤和滑点控制参数，避免在恶劣交易条件下下单
improvements_en: Implement the FIXED_PERCENT money management mode or remove unused enum and include file to maintain code consistency
Fix the iteration-while-deleting bug in DeleteAllOrders by iterating backwards or collecting tickets first then deleting
Call PositionSelect with the correct ticket before reading position properties in CheckPosition to ensure accurate data
Add spread filter and slippage control parameters to avoid placing orders under adverse trading conditions

risk_points: DeleteAllOrders遍历删除可能导致部分订单未被删除，造成意外挂单成交
CheckPosition中未正确选择仓位可能读取错误仓位属性导致错误平仓
无点差过滤机制，高波动时段可能以不利价格成交
risk_points_en: DeleteAllOrders iteration-while-deleting bug may leave some orders undeleted, causing unexpected order fills
Incorrect position selection in CheckPosition may read wrong position attributes leading to erroneous closes
No spread filter mechanism, potentially filling at unfavorable prices during high-volatility periods
